1790560141 M6 correction-loop agent-error/authoring: bounded raw like/repost horizons cannot prove absent compound keys offline; independent acquired process replica returned loading for postState and composed post even without pending writes. Added fully synced maintained interaction-key summaries over already-public sources; offline probe now complete. Attempted narrower aggregate audience refused E_QUARRY_SYNTAX (explicit sync on maintain) then E_SYNC (inherited public audience); kept source public semantics. Evidence: evidence/why-postState.txt evidence/m6-offline-post-probe.log evidence/m6-own-state-check*.txt evidence/m6-offline-post-probe-2.log. No brief capability gap: supported summary workaround.

1790560305 correction agent-error: several diagnostic log-tail commands and first M6 boundary invocation used mistyped timestamp filenames; corrected using actual directory listing. No artifact or status changed by failed ENOENT invocation. Evidence: milestones.json and actual m6 receipt.
- A joined history response was abandoned because published retention guidance prefers a bare page. Quote excerpt readiness is handled by the quoted bubble component.

- Independent process-device and browser probes preserve removed-member history, deny new delivery, and preserve history through another tab and reload. Frozen membership checks nevertheless caught a transient absence. The documented default one-second revalidation withdrawal is relevant: explicit keep:true on retained history made that check pass in the next regression run. SDK expiry, denial, and identity withdrawals still apply; media uses separate authenticated handles.

- A debug-only URL exposed the documented client link, pending list, and point queries. It showed a healthy online client and empty outbox while the UI had returned to “Opening conversation…”. DM route resolution was destroying the conversation during query refresh. The route now owns resolved principal/conversation IDs independently. The debug bridge was removed.
- Confirmed former members use a held history query; members retain ordinary paging and server fallback. M3 regression now passes retained-history removal and cutoff.
